nvitk.morphology.binary
=======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.morphology.binary

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Binary (and gray) morphological operators: dilate, erode, open, close, fill_holes.

---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.morphology.binary.dilate

   nvitk.morphology.binary.close

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: dilate(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, footprint: int | Any | None = None, *, iterations: int = 1, mode: str = 'binary', isotropic: bool = False, spacing: Sequence[float] | None = None, connectivity: int = 2) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Morphological dilation.

   :param img: Input mask (:class:`Image` or array).
   :param footprint: Structuring element. ``None`` → unit ball; ``int`` → iterated unit ball
                     of that radius; array → used as-is (cast to the active backend).
   :param iterations: Passed to ``ndi.binary_dilation`` (integer ≥ 1).
   :param mode: ``"binary"`` or ``"gray"``.
   :param isotropic: When ``footprint`` is ``int`` and ``isotropic=True``, resample the
                     ball to isotropic voxels using ``spacing``.
   :param spacing: When ``footprint`` is ``int`` and ``isotropic=True``, resample the
                   ball to isotropic voxels using ``spacing``.
   :param connectivity: Base connectivity for the unit structure (1 = face, 2 = edge, ...).


.. py:function:: erode(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, footprint: int | Any | None = None, *, iterations: int = 1, mode: str = 'binary', isotropic: bool = False, spacing: Sequence[float] | None = None, connectivity: int = 1) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Morphological erosion (counterpart to :func:`dilate`).


.. py:function:: open(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, footprint: int | Any | None = None, *, iterations: int = 1, mode: str = 'binary', isotropic: bool = False, spacing: Sequence[float] | None = None, connectivity: int = 1) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Morphological opening = erode followed by dilate.


.. py:function:: close(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, footprint: int | Any | None = None, *, iterations: int = 1, mode: str = 'binary', isotropic: bool = False, spacing: Sequence[float] | None = None, connectivity: int = 1) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Morphological closing = dilate followed by erode.


.. py:function:: fill_holes(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, axis: int | None = None, structure: Any | None = None, mode: str = 'binary') -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Fill holes in a binary mask.

   :param img: Input binary mask.
   :param axis: If provided, apply slicewise along *axis* (useful for axial fills that
                should not close inter-slice voids). If ``None``, fill in 3D.
   :param structure: See ``scipy.ndimage.binary_fill_holes``.
   :param mode: See ``scipy.ndimage.binary_fill_holes``.
